## Findings

### AUTH_ATTRIBUTE (HIGH, 1)

- Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer: JWT bearer authentication needs issuer and audience configuration under spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver. `Legacy.Api.csproj`

### UNKNOWN_PACKAGE (HIGH, 2)

- NuGet package Polly 8.4.1 has no known Maven equivalent. Nothing was added; find a replacement. `Legacy.Api.csproj`
- NuGet package Hangfire.Core 1.8.14 has no known Maven equivalent. Nothing was added; find a replacement. `Legacy.Api.csproj`

### CONNECTION_STRING_FORMAT (MEDIUM, 1)

- Connection string DefaultConnection was converted to a JDBC URL (jdbc:sqlserver://db.internal:1433;databaseName=Legacy;trustServerCertificate=true). ADO.NET and JDBC options differ; review it, and move the password to an environment variable. `appsettings.json`

### PACKAGE_MAPPING (MEDIUM, 3)

- Serilog.AspNetCore: Logging is built in through spring-boot-starter-logging (Logback). Serilog sinks and enrichers need re-creating in logback-spring.xml. `Legacy.Api.csproj`
- AutoMapper: MapStruct replaces AutoMapper, but mapping profiles do not translate and must be rewritten as mapper interfaces. `Legacy.Api.csproj`
- FluentValidation.AspNetCore: FluentValidation rules are code, not attributes, and were not translated. Re-express them as Bean Validation constraints. `Legacy.Api.csproj`

### CONFIG_KEY (INFO, 2)

- Log level for .NET category Legacy.Jobs was dropped: the category has no Java counterpart. Set logging.level for your own packages instead. `appsettings.json`
- AllowedHosts was dropped: Spring has no host filtering; do it at the proxy. `appsettings.json`
